{{Quote|&hellip;TIE fighters&mdash;coming from the ''moon''! The Imps must have a ''base'' on Folor!|[[Nera Dantels]]|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' ½]]</ref>}}
'''Folor Base''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Folor]] during the early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] were stationed on the base. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], several TIE fighters were launched from the base in an attempt to stop [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] from escaping the system with a cargo of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]].
